tagline: Eighteen anchor markets + Metro Atlanta density — statewide reach without pretending every county is the same.

corridors.name: I-16
corridors.role: Macon → Savannah east-west freight and retail

corridors.name: I-85
corridors.role: Atlanta → LaGrange → Alabama border west flank

metroAtlanta.name: Metro Atlanta
metroAtlanta.role: Highest liquidity, fastest SLA proof, recruit and partner HQ narrative.
metroAtlanta.partnerPitch: Default overflow bench for national partners; density for sub-4hr SLAs inside the Perimeter and I-285 corridors.

regions.name: State extremes & corners
regions.description: Anchor the geographic box so no partner WO is 'too far from Atlanta' on paper.

regions.name: Central anchors (heart of Georgia)
regions.description: Macon is the geographic center (I-75 × I-16). Middle-of-state WOs route here first.

regions.name: Deep South (I-75 corridor)
regions.description: South-central logistics and retail between Macon and Florida.

regions.name: North & Northeast
regions.description: Mountains, I-985, and university-heavy north Georgia.

regions.name: Western interstate (I-85 corridor)
regions.description: Fills the long gap between Atlanta and Columbus along the Alabama flank.

regions.name: Eastern inland
regions.description: Rural gap between Augusta and the coast.

anchors.name: Dalton
anchors.role: I-75 corridor at the Tennessee line; carpet/logistics belt and NW Georgia retail.
anchors.partnerPitch: Northwest corner coverage without routing everything through Atlanta.

anchors.name: Bainbridge / Albany
anchors.role: SW corner (FL/AL borders); Albany is the recognized hub for all of southwest Georgia.
anchors.partnerPitch: Southwest GA hub — critical for ag, healthcare, and retail chains south of Macon.

anchors.name: Savannah / Brunswick
anchors.role: Coastal east; Brunswick pushes to the southeastern corner; port and tourism logistics.
anchors.partnerPitch: Coastal SLA coverage — ports, hospitality, and I-16 retail corridors.

anchors.name: Augusta
anchors.role: SC border; healthcare, manufacturing, and CSRA retail.
anchors.partnerPitch: Eastern extreme — CSRA enterprise and retail without Atlanta drive time.

anchors.name: Columbus
anchors.role: Middle-western anchor on the Alabama border.
anchors.partnerPitch: West GA anchor for Fort Moore corridor and Alabama-border retail.

anchors.name: Macon / Warner Robins
anchors.role: Literal center of GA (I-75 × I-16). Fast reach to any middle-of-state WO.
anchors.partnerPitch: Mandatory central hub — one Macon tech covers more of GA per mile than any other single anchor.

anchors.name: Valdosta
anchors.role: Deep southern middle on I-75 before Florida.
anchors.partnerPitch: South GA I-75 stop — logistics, education, and FL-border retail.

anchors.name: Tifton
anchors.role: Between Macon and Valdosta; major south-central logistics crossroads.
anchors.partnerPitch: Ag and distribution belt between central and deep south.

anchors.name: Gainesville
anchors.role: NE Georgia and I-985 into the mountains.
anchors.partnerPitch: Northeast anchor — lake country retail and mountain corridor overflow.

anchors.name: Athens
anchors.role: Major regional hub for eastern north Georgia; university and healthcare.
anchors.partnerPitch: Eastern north GA — UGA market and I-85 north corridor.

anchors.name: Rome
anchors.role: Rugged NW between Atlanta and Tennessee; healthcare and manufacturing.
anchors.partnerPitch: NW interior — covers gap between Atlanta and Dalton.

anchors.name: LaGrange / Newnan
anchors.role: Western I-85 toward Alabama; fills Atlanta–Columbus gap.
anchors.partnerPitch: West-side I-85 bench — automotive, logistics, and Coweta county retail.

anchors.name: Statesboro
anchors.role: University town; fills rural gap between Augusta and Savannah.
anchors.partnerPitch: Inland east — Boro corridor without coast premium pricing.

rolloutPhases.name: Core density
rolloutPhases.goal: Prove SLA, payouts, and partner pilot KPIs.

rolloutPhases.name: Regional hubs
rolloutPhases.goal: Cover the six corners + center so partners can say 'statewide' honestly.

rolloutPhases.name: Corridor fill
rolloutPhases.goal: Close I-75 / I-85 / I-16 gaps between hubs.

rolloutPhases.name: Deep rural & corners
rolloutPhases.goal: SW box complete; long-radius techs with realistic drive-time pricing.

minimumBenchTargets.notes: Pilot honesty: market 'statewide coordination' once Phase 1 hubs each have ≥ targetTechsMin; full box after Phase 3.
